summary.independent_method: Exhaustive 63 subsets with independent fixed-open HiGHS LP
summary.baseline_definition: Illustrative as-is: all six candidate DCs leased for 12 months, with minimum freight-and-handling flow assignment subject to service/capacity; NOT actual EFERT as-is. This is a relaxed nearest-cost-feasible benchmark, not strict single-zone nearest assignment.
summary.inventory_method: Provisional DC safety stock and monthly holding rate included as fixed reserve per opened DC. No physical inventory storage-capacity constraint because throughput capacity is not storage capacity; no dynamic stock-flow or reorder-point balance.
summary.provenance: [DERIVED] from Phase 3 synthetic and assumed inputs, not company operating results
limitations: Synthetic inventory model requires instructor acceptance
Warehouse throughput capacity is not storage capacity
Freight routes are circuity estimates, not verified truck lanes
All six baseline DC leases are a counterfactual assumption, not observed EFERT current network
Production costs excluded equally from both alternatives
36 months of history; 12 months (2025) used for decision horizon

thresholds.interpretation: Below threshold fewer DCs can be cost-optimal
Lower DC capacity can force opening the sixth DC
Above threshold plant or DC capacity insufficient
Below threshold combined DC throughput insufficient
